==Notes==
{{bug|The effects of this skill apply to non-spell skills as well.}}
*"Other allies" refers to allies (including the shout's user) that are not the recipient of this shout. Self-targeted skills, untargeted skills, party-wide AoE skills, etc. do not interact with this shout, even if the recipient is being targeted when they are cast and those skills affect the recipient.
*The health gain occurs after damage on skill activation from skills like [[Spiteful Spirit]] or [[Environment Effect]]s like [[Dreadful Pain]].

==Trivia==
*The [[skill icon]] resembles that of the skill [["Go for the Eyes!"]]. Also, the two figures below the paragon in the icon are necromancers wearing [[Necromancer Sunspear armor|Sunspear armor]], the same figure shown in [["Never Surrender!"]].
*This skill was named ''"Help Me!"'' until the 21st [[Anniversary Celebration]] skill update on [[Feedback:Game_updates/20260428#Paragon|April 28, 2026]]. See the [["Help!"/Skill_history|skill history]] for details.
*The user of this skill shouts "Help Me!" when targeting themselves and "Help Them!" when targeting an ally.
